propositions: Planning mixes snapshot reads, binding decisions, and global mode caps without isolating pure plan computation from lifecycle effects or remote operations.
Build immutable observation and TicketPlan values per ticket identity, containing mutations, lifecycle intents, dependencies, diagnostics, and disposition before any I/O or lifecycle execution.
Selection, filtering, mode caps, and global safety limits must be applied before lifecycle intents are eligible, and unselected tickets must never be mutated.
Create-before-link and parent-before-child prerequisites must be explicit in plans; blocked work yields a deferred disposition rather than out-of-order mutations.
Shadow mode emits versioned lifecycle-intent metadata alongside existing mutation array and hash while preserving backward compatibility and performing zero writes.
